title: Kamishiro Rui — Brilliance At Twilight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
It's the Captain of the blue team!
The other squad members are by the classroom windows too... What are they all doing there...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: Way to go, blue cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: You guys gave us so much energy!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line:
We might be in last right now...
But it's not over until it's over!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Captain, I think your passion's touched everyone's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How was it?! Absolutely perfect, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it was a wonderful performance.
There's no room for me to complain.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! That just leaves the voting for the cheering competition! I hope they finish counting soon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. But we should also take this opportunity to head back to our class waiting areas... We still have the next event to think about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! We need to start gathering soon! Let's go, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay. See you, Rui!
Let's meet up later to talk more about the cheering competition!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, we just managed to get in a peek! The cheering competition was so amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I haven't had a chance to thank Luka and the others yet.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Perfect timing.
About the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, those two are back! Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: The blue team's performance was so good!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think it's coming from the waiting area for my class.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Thanks, you guys!
I'm glad you all liked our performance so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, being the representatives for Class B was definitely worth it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rui, aren't they on your cheer squad? Hehe. Everyone around them's smiling so much.>

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
Seriously, that opening scene was nuts!
No one expected you guys to jump out of the windows!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Kamishiro came up with that part.
We didn't have much time to practice it, so I wasn't sure we'd be able to pull it off.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't really for it either at first...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Really...? It definitely looked really cool, but he's actually the one who came up with that idea...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I should tell the Captain that I need to head back to my class for now. I'll be right back...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
And everything went okay?
You didn't get hurt or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
No, we were totally fine.
Kamishiro made sure to put safety first.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah! You guys gotta hear this!
It was incredible!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, here! This says how we practiced that window jump, but they're all a little different depending on which clubs we're in or what we're good at doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: He even went around to each of us to explain how our safety equipment all works.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. And just in case we didn't land properly, he had a safety mat ready to catch us.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: That made such a huge difference when it came to actually getting ourselves to jump.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Really...? I never would've expected Kamishiro to be so thoughtful of others.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I mean, it's impossible to tell what he's thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: I felt the same way, but he seemed really different during practice...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: It was like you could tell he shared our wish. As if he was thinking, “I want to encourage everyone by making this performance a success.”

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: I see... So Kamishiro went through all that trouble to give us encouragement...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rui, why don't you head back to your class?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Look! Kamishiro's back!
We should be there to welcome him!>

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Hey, you're late!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
It's good to be back...
